title: Applied AI Engineer | Revolut India
content:
# Applied AI Engineer

Remote: Austria  · Cyprus  · Czech Republic  · Germany  · Hungary  · Poland  · Portugal  · Spain

### About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

### About the role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions, collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for an Applied AI Engineer who can manage their product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.

From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your product.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

### What you'll be doing

* Owning the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered solutions, leveraging LLMs and other machine learning technologies
* Collaborating closely with Data Scientists and Software Engineers to deliver impactful solutions
* Leading cross-functional teams to build and deploy NLP and AI solutions, such as AI assistants and AI automation platforms
* Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
* Delivering measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

### What you'll need

* Experience developing and launching AI products/features from scratch
* High analytical and technical acumen, along with solid business sense and problem-solving skills
* Experience in a data science or machine learning role
* Experience owning machine learning projects, from design to implementation and iteration
* Great Python, SQL, or other programming language skills
* Hands-on experience with deep learning libs (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, etc.)
* Knowledge of version control, model deployment, and developer environments
* Evidence of impressive mathematical and statistical knowledge
* An entrepreneurial drive to never settle

### Compensation range

* Poland: PLN27,000 - PLN53,300 gross monthly\*
* Austria: €90,000 - €168,000 gross annually\*
* Other locations: Compensation will be dis
stack: AI / LLM, React, Next.js, TypeScript, AWS, Docker

**This is Adyen**

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for global customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft, making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. We create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by a culture that encourages ownership and provides the support to truly own your career. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team, delivering innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

**The Opportunity**

Adyen is building a **top-tier AI engineering team in San Francisco** to drive our next chapter of innovation using AI globally across the entire company. This is a **highly technical, hands-on role** focused on the **exploration and application of cutting-edge AI research** within the financial technology sector. As a **Member of Technical Staff**, you will operate with a **high degree of autonomy and responsibility**, delivering **strategic, high-impact outcomes** that bridge the gap between advanced AI research and production-grade applications at a global scale, potentially impacting trillions of dollars in transactions annually.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Innovate and Deploy: Drive the execution of Adyen's AI strategy**, focusing on the **practical application of Generative AI (GenAI) and other AI methodologies in finance**. * **Think Outside the Box: Drive innovation by challenging the status quo**, introducing transformative ideas and implementing creative solutions to solve real-world problems. Carry out **flexible, value-driven assignments**, proactively unblocking teams to maximize organizational impact and drive strategic initiatives.

title: Senior Software Engineer - ML & AI (AI Products)
content:
# Senior Software Engineer - ML & AI (AI Products)

* Sydney / Australia
* Hybrid
* Data, AI & Machine Learning
* R0018438

## The Role

**The role**

You will design, build and own the production systems behind Xero’s AI features: the services, pipelines and infrastructure that power LLM-driven and agentic experiences for millions of small businesses every day. This is a software engineering role. You’ll build and operate systems rather than train or tune models, and your architecture decisions will directly shape scale, cost, reliability and how fast our teams ship.

You don’t need a machine learning background. We’re looking for strong production engineers, ideally with experience building LLM or agentic systems, and ML depth can be learned on the team.

Beyond architecture, you’ll lift engineering capability across AI Products by setting standards, mentoring engineers and partnering across Xero to make data usable and systems dependable.

**The team**

You’ll join AI Products, a diverse, globally distributed team of scientists, engineers, product managers and analysts within our broader Data & AI business.

Engineers here partner closely with Applied Scientists early on to build the interfaces and harnesses that take models into production. They then own the engineering and infrastructure of every ML and AI system shipped into production, from reliability and cost to scale. Together, this collaborative team reduces toil and delivers reliable, intelligent experiences for small businesses.

**The team is currently working on**

* **Production ML and AI engineering:** Building and operating the platforms, services and practices that support traditional ML models, generative AI and agentic systems in production.
* **JAX (Just Ask Xero):** Powering Xero's conversational GenAI assistant and evolving the underlying capabilities to support increasingly sophisticated, context-aware and agentic experiences.
* **Intelligent financial workflows:** Developing capabilities such as Automated Bank Reconciliation and smart document capture, using ML and AI to match transactions, extract information from bills and receipts, and automate complex tasks.
* **XeroForce:** Building the platform for AI-powered workflows, enabling agents to plan and execute complex tasks across Xero’s products and supporting reliable, reusable agentic experiences at scale.
* **End-to-end AI product experiences:** Integrating AI into customer-facing experiences and product workflows, alongside the backend services, orchestration and infrastructure that make them work.

**Where and how you can work**

Xero offers a flexible hybrid working model designed to blend the collaboration of office life with the autonomy of remote work. You will have access to our modern office spaces, with expectations around office days and collaborative 'boost days' aligned to help your team connect and ship great code effectively.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (f/m/d) | Jobs at OH-SO Digital
content:
# Senior Frontend Developer (f/m/d)

Remote Germany, Berlin, Hamburg, München, Prague

Full-time

Permanent employee

## What to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. 

Responsibility

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. Pipedrive made a splash in Lisbon during Web Summit 2016, and our journey took off with the opening of our Lisbon office in 2017. After a few moves, we’re thrilled to call our vibrant Casal Ribeiro space home as of 2023.

## Our traditions

At our Lisbon office, we thrive on community and collaboration. We cherish lunch breaks to recharge, and as foodies, our official office cake is the delightful Bola de Berlin (bet you thought it was Pastel de Nata). The Lisbon office is also one of the few Pipedrive locations that goes all out for its birthday, a tradition the team takes very seriously.

With such a talented team of customer solutions experts, we host regular “One Day in Your Shoes” events to show off the incredible results they deliver for our customers. We’re also active contributors to Lisbon’s engineering scene, hosting meetups and participating in conferences, and love giving back to the wider community – whether we’re supporting animal welfare or rolling up our sleeves for local blood drives.

Outside of work, we stay active with monthly hikes, competitive padel, table tennis and football, strengthening bonds and team spirit. We’re also big on celebrating. Summer brings Summer Garage, our annual festival uniting Pipedrivers from around the world, alongside the family-friendly Pipekids event that fills the office with children and laughter. The year closes with our festive winter awards show, honoring achievements with sparkle, applause and shared pride.

## Where you’ll find us

Our Lisbon office is based at Avenida Casal Ribeiro, in Saldanha – right in the middle of the Lisbon business district.

We share our office building with other exciting digital companies, but our lovely terrace on the first floor is exclusively for Pipedrivers! Our all-hands area has an auditorium for regular company-wide meetings, a kitchen filled with snacks and drinks (including yummy ice cream) and a gaming area. The building also offers free parking spots and a gym for us!

# Berlin

Hallo! Welcome to our Berlin office, located in the European capital for innovation and digitization.

## About us

Welcome to Pipedrive Germany, our vibrant new hub right in the heart of West Berlin!

Opened on November 23, 2021, it’s now home to 40+ professionals from 15+ countries, all united by a passion for building, learning and growing together.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive Berlin, we believe that a strong team is built not just on passion for our work, but also on the joy of spending time together. With our diverse roots and cultural backgrounds, we bond over cuisine evenings, sharing everything from Korean bibimbap to Portuguese pastéis de nata. Plus, we love to bring back tasty souvenirs from our travels – nothing brings a team together like food!

We’re all about exploring Berlin and soaking in the local culture, too! We love mixing things up and trying new activities together, but some traditions are too good to change. When Oktoberfest rolls around, there’s one place you’ll find us: at our favorite brewery, enjoying good beer, good food and even better company.

And the fun doesn’t stop there. To end the year on a high, our winter award show brings laughter, creative sketches and special appearances from our kids, pets and even our customers!

## Where you’ll find us

Our Berlin office is located on the city’s vibrant west side, just around the corner from the iconic Kurfürstendamm. Surrounded by some of Berlin’s best shopping streets, restaurants, coffee shops and rooftop spots, it’s an inspiring place to work and connect.

The workspace features a dedicated Pipedrive-only floor, plus two additional co-working floors operated by Mindspace, giving you plenty of options for focused work and collaboration. Enjoy rooftop terraces with city views, an on-site barista and welcoming spaces designed to bring teams together.

Whether you’re brainstorming with colleagues, grabbing a coffee or soaking up the neighborhood after work, our Berlin office has everything you need to do your best work.

## Meet our team

From a welcoming and respectful environment to a passion for growth and collaboration, we believe in creating a workplace where every voice matters. Join us on this journey where work becomes a source of joy, learning, and genuine connections. Together, let's redefine success and enjoy the ride!

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

The Role:

The team is at the center of Aiven's move into agentic AI. We build the platform and tooling that let AI agents and developers work with data on Aiven, from the agent runtimes and the interfaces that connect large language models to real systems, to the product experiences on top of them. Our work ships fast, reaches customers and AI agents directly, and defines how Aiven's data platform is used in an AI-first world.

We are looking for an experienced full-stack engineer to help design and build these AI and agentic products end to end. You'll be part of a small, senior team that owns its work from idea to production. Our backend services are written in Python and TypeScript, our agents run on frontier LLMs, and our frontend uses React and TypeScript, all on top of Aiven's own data platform.

What You'll Do: Writing high quality, maintainable code and releasing quality features Contributing to technical planning and backlog management Helping investigate and resolve customer issues Mentor and empower other engineers around you What We're Looking For:

Must-have:

Excellent development skills in Python, TypeScript, and React Excellent understanding of Agentic AI systems Ability to independently solve challenges, break tasks and push to desired outcome Ability to write good automated tests Experience using Linux in development Fluency in English, verbal and written Deep, daily use of AI agents in your own development workflow: you go beyond Cursor or Claude Code as autocomplete, and build your own MCP servers, skills, custom tools and automated agent workflows to multiply your output.

Distributed systems knowledge

Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t line up perfectly – we still encourage you to apply! We believe in investing in our crabs’ professional growth.

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!
